feeding_claim.verbatim: 100% grassfed and finished beef and lamb

resold_note: The CSA also includes grains, flours and dry beans from other regional growers.
notes: Year-round whole-diet CSA farm on Route 22 at Essex, about a mile from the Essex-Charlotte ferry. Found through the NY raw milk permit holder list (lead). Checked the homepage, CSA page, FAQ and our farmers page. The CSA page lists 100% grassfed and finished beef and lamb, organically fed pastured pork and chicken, eggs from pastured organically fed hens, and raw milk and dairy products from the farm's grassfed Jersey herd; the about page says any grain fed is grown on the farm or certified organic. Members pick up weekly at the farm (Fridays 3 to 7 pm, weekends also allowed); the FAQ says the farm no longer delivers. A self-serve farm store open 24/7 sells grassfed meat, raw milk and produce. Membership is priced per person per week (2026: adults $115). The site names other dairy products but not which ones, so only raw-milk is recorded. No phone or bulk shares found. Raw milk sales are legal only in some states. The Verifier may confirm the farm is still on the NY raw milk permit list.
